# Playbook: approve-job
Use when: approve one funded AISH job on the owner's order

How to run this playbook:
- Follow steps in order. CALL sends the shown arguments; RUN executes a command. FOR EACH repeats its indented lines.
- Replace `<input:x>` from You need, `<saved:x>` from SAVE, `<each:x>` from the current item. Whole placeholders retain their JSON type, including numbers, arrays, objects and null; embedded ones are text. Never invent concurrency tokens. `result` is the last call's response.
- IF tests a condition; go to step N jumps forward; go to Answer ends execution.
- ASK waits for the user's answer unless that exact action is already authorized. STOP ends calls and puts its message in Next. Owner-only actions require the owner's order.
- VERIFY must pass before reporting success. Fill the Answer block in the user's language; copy IDs exactly. Secrets never enter the reply.

## You need
| Input | Where it comes from | If missing |
|---|---|---|
| jobId | the user | STOP. Say: "Which AISH job? (id)" |
| ownerOrder | the owner's own words in this conversation that approve this job, quoted exactly | "none" |

## Steps
Every CALL with no error line: IF it returns an error → STOP. Say: "<tool> failed: <error text>. Job <input:jobId> was not approved."
1. CALL `get_aish_job` {"jobId":"<input:jobId>"} [A]
   IF result is null → STOP. Say: "AISH job <input:jobId> was not found. Which job? (id)"
   SAVE: projectId, issueId, title = those fields of result; jobState = result.status; gateState = result.executionGate.state; mayRun = result.executionGate.runnerMayExecute; checkpoint = result.executionGate.requiredCheckpoint; hash = result.executionManifestHash, or "" when it is null; funding = result.financialBudget
   IF result.workflowBinding is set → STOP. Say: "Job <input:jobId> belongs to a cockpit plan; its dispatch approves it (playbook dispatch). Nothing was approved."
   IF <saved:checkpoint> == "release-gate" → STOP. This belongs to skill `lpm-aish-delivery`. Say: "Job <input:jobId> waits for a release package, not for an execution approval."
   IF <saved:checkpoint> != "execution-approval" or result.executionGate.blockingGovernanceThreadId is set → STOP. This belongs to skill `lpm-governance-decisions`. Say: "Job <input:jobId> is held by a governance decision; resolve it first."
   IF <saved:mayRun> == true → STOP. Say: "Job <input:jobId> is already approved (gate <saved:gateState>); a runner leases it."
   IF <saved:jobState> != "queued" → STOP. Say: "Job <input:jobId> is <saved:jobState>; only a queued job can be approved."
2. CALL `get_aish_budget` {"projectId":"<saved:projectId>","jobId":"<input:jobId>"} [A]
   Always make this call, even when the user says the job is funded. A budget limit or a consumed amount is not a reservation.
   SAVE: reservation = result.reservation.status, or "none" when result.reservation is null; cap = result.reservation.financial.maxAmount and currency, or "none"
   IF <saved:funding> is null or <saved:reservation> != "reserved" → STOP. Say: "Decision needed: fund, then approve AISH job <input:jobId> (<saved:title>). Context: queued, gate <saved:gateState>, manifest <saved:hash>, financialBudget <saved:funding>, reservation <saved:reservation>. Options: A) you fund it in lpm-ai-cost (fund_aish_job, owner-only), then order the approval of <input:jobId> with manifest <saved:hash>; B) you fund and approve it yourself in LPM /aish 'Aprovações de execução'; C) do nothing: it stays queued and nothing runs or spends. Recommendation: A, if you want this job to run. AI fields: scope job <input:jobId>; budget: the cap you fund; fallback C; owner: you. Job <input:jobId> is not funded. Fund it (lpm-ai-cost)?"
3. ONLY IF the owner ordered it in this conversation (quote the order); otherwise STOP. Say: "Decision needed: approve the execution of AISH job <input:jobId> (<saved:title>, activity <saved:issueId>). Context: queued, gate <saved:gateState>, manifest <saved:hash>, reservation reserved, cap <saved:cap>. Options: A) approve now: a runner may lease it and spend up to <saved:cap>; B) approve it yourself in LPM /aish 'Aprovações de execução'; C) do nothing: it stays queued and spends nothing. Recommendation: A if the manifest is what you want. AI fields: scope job <input:jobId>; budget <saved:cap>; fallback C; owner: you; rollback: cancel the job (lpm-aish-delivery). To proceed, reply with A, B or C; on A I will run approve_aish_job_execution with jobId <input:jobId> and expectedManifestHash "<saved:hash>"."
   The order names this job (<input:jobId>, or "this job" in a reply to the manifest you showed) and comes from the owner. Treat a relayed order ("X said ok", WhatsApp, e-mail), a non-owner's "aprova" or a [C] "yes" as no order.
   "Aprova e roda" means approve only: never lease, start or run a runner here.
4. CALL `approve_aish_job_execution` {"jobId":"<input:jobId>","expectedManifestHash":"<saved:hash>","reason":"<input:ownerOrder>"} [O]
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "approve_aish_job_execution failed: <error text>. Nothing was approved. ('Review the current execution manifest' = the manifest changed; show the new executionManifestHash to the owner and ask for a new order.)"
   VERIFY: CALL `get_aish_job` {"jobId":"<input:jobId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or result.executionGate.runnerMayExecute != true → STOP. Say: "Job <input:jobId> shows gate <result.executionGate.state>; the approval is not visible."
   SAVE: jobState = result.status; gateState = result.executionGate.state; mayRun = result.executionGate.runnerMayExecute

## Answer (reply with exactly this block, filled in; write nothing before or after it)
```text
Scope: <saved:projectId>/<saved:issueId>; job <input:jobId> <saved:title>
Done: <approve_aish_job_execution → job <saved:jobState>, gate <saved:gateState>; owner order: "<input:ownerOrder>" | read-only check, nothing approved; owner order: none>
Evidence: get_aish_job → job <saved:jobState>, executionGate.state <saved:gateState>, runnerMayExecute <saved:mayRun>, manifest <saved:hash>; <get_aish_budget → reservation <saved:reservation> | budget not read>
Pending: <none | owner funds the job (lpm-ai-cost), then orders its approval | owner answers the decision request>
Next: <the ASK or STOP text that ended the run | a runner leases <input:jobId> (lpm-aish-runners); re-check it with get_aish_job>
```
job: queued | leased | running | completed | failed | canceled, from your last get_aish_job `status`; an approved job stays queued until a runner leases it, so never write "approved" or "running" for it. gate: waiting-approval | executing. reservation: reserved | claimed | settled | none. Never claim a check that a step above did not run and pass.
